authority.definition: One turn is one turn_start→turn_end pair when those markers exist; fallback logs without markers use one user prompt plus following assistant/tool rows.
authority.why: The real omp excerpt carries six turn_start/turn_end pairs and six assistant message_end records; the reader ignored markers and split only on user messages, producing one.

finding: Reader segmentation was wrong for marker-bearing excerpts; manifest turn range and marker count were authoritative.
no_claim: No fixture files were edited; this receipt only records the measured denominator defect and source-level hypothesis.
